exposure: Gestational age at delivery (≥40 weeks or not)
outcome: Total nucleated cell count in cord blood
Percentage of CD34+ cells in cord blood
finding: Cesarean delivery and birth weight over 3500g were associated with higher cord blood volume and total nucleated cell count, while gestational age over 38 weeks was only associated with higher volume.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher cord blood volume and total nucleated cell count compared to vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Data collected on gestational age at delivery, with a majority ≥40 weeks
birth_weight: Data collected on birth weight, with categories of 3000-3499g, <3000g, and >3500g
